quote.zh: （示例文字）这里放一段对方同意公开的原话，说明技能在一个真实项目里起了什么作用。
quote.en: (Sample text) A sentence the person agreed to publish, about what the skill did in one real project.

quote.zh: （示例文字）教学里怎么用它比较方向、让学生看到取舍，由对方自己说。
quote.en: (Sample text) How it is used in teaching to compare directions and show trade-offs, in the person's own words.

quote.zh: （示例文字）从需求到三个能跑的方向用了多久、最后选了哪个，由对方自己说。
quote.en: (Sample text) How long it took from brief to three running directions and which one shipped, in the person's own words.
